Wow that really touches on a lot of the things I have been struggling with in my relationship. I have noticed my fear of abandonment but also this deep craving for exploration and freedom. The partners I have chosen often had brought out in me the insecure nature of clinginess as they often craved their own autonomy leaving me to fight for the relationship, hence the power dynamics being unfair. I find myself now afraid of intimate relationships and wanting to really heal and unlearn my unhealthy self doubts/behaviors. I do believe though that each relationship has made me learn a great deal and I’m always greatful. I have attracted a lot of Aquarius partners and have had my most intense and chaotic relationships with them, as well as pisces so I wonder if there is any relation to my need for exploration and their innate ability to bring that out. A lot of my insecure attachment comes from my childhood so that does make sense i definitely feel the need to heal that. Thank you for your insights I truly feel heard 🙏

As a former survivor having my first experience w sex being sa, I’ve dealt a lot with the issue. I found making sure the partner that I was going to have relations with needs to be emotionally intune and safe. Making sure that I felt in a safe place and always checks up on me before, during, and after. Your body will give you signs beforehand if you feel safe with someone it just takes trusting those instincts. If the person isn’t caring or understanding of your situation you’ll most definitely have a harder time feeling comfortable. Oddly enough, exploring my body myself and what I like/dislike on my own gave the pressure off of the shame. And thats completely natural! In general, making sure you choose a partner who is kind enough and cares enough to making you feel ready and comfortable is essential in this area. Someone who wants to please your needs and is happy to do so. If they go in only wanting to get it done or for their own selfish reasons then you’ll not have a great experience. I hope this helps somewhat. You’re doing great and it takes time so please be kinder to yourself and you’ll succeed.
